rows.grounds: nominative plural masculine of pumāṃs; final visarga sandhi before deveśi
vocative singular feminine address to the goddess
compound adjective mahākāla plus svarūpin in nominative plural masculine agreeing with pumāṃso

items.question: What form do men take then according to this teaching?
items.inference: The verse identifies men at that time with the form of Mahākāla.
uncertainties: exact ritual context of the transformation is not supplied by this verse alone
items.plain_english: Then, O goddess, men are of the form of Mahākāla.
